# ItemESP

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** ItemEsp, ItemESP

## What it does

ItemESP highlights dropped items and collectible projectiles in the world, making them visible through terrain and at a distance. It is useful for quickly spotting valuable loot on the ground, tracking arrows you have fired, or locating tridents before they despawn.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/itemesp). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
